title: Michael Jackson (with drummer Jonathan Moffett) "They Don't Care About Us"  (Munich 1997)
desc:
Michael Jackson delivers an explosive performance of “They Don’t Care About Us” during the HIStory World Tour in Munich, 1997. Performed as part of the show’s iconic opening medley, the song combined powerful choreography, military-inspired rhythms, and an unmatched stage presence that helped make the HIStory Tour one of the most ambitious concert productions of its era.

Nearly three decades later, this performance remains one of the defining moments of the HIStory era and a testament to Michael Jackson’s ability to command a stadium audience like no other.

title: Pemerintah Brazil melarang, tapi video MICHAEL JACKSON ini tetap syuting di Favela
desc:
Tahun 1996, Michael Jackson ingin syuting lagu They Don’t Care About Us di favela Brasil. Permintaan izin sempat ditolak karena dianggap bisa merusak citra negara.
Namun proyek ini tetap berjalan. Bersama sutradara Spike Lee, proses syuting akhirnya berlangsung di Santa Marta (Rio) dan Pelourinho (Salvador), menghadirkan energi komunitas lokal serta pesan kuat tentang ketidakadilan sosial.
Video ini kemudian menjadi salah satu karya paling berani MJ, menampilkan realitas kehidupan, kemarahan dan suara yang jarang terdengar.
